title: Signal Sprint - Offline Route Puzzle
customer_problem: A small offline route-planning game with short, replayable puzzle rounds.
audience: Casual Windows players seeking a keyboard-friendly offline puzzle.
differentiation: Deterministic 8x8 route puzzle with clear win/loss, save/load and bilingual labels.
scope: Collect three cells and reach EXIT before the move limit
Support keyboard and adjacent mouse movement
Provide distinct win and loss states and restart
